items.title: Applied Digital (APLD) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Split On AI Buildout
items.summary: Applied Digital’s latest valuation work has trimmed the Fair Value estimate from US$73.36 to US$68.35, which reduces the implied upside case within this model. Analysts linking this shift to the current debate around contracted capacity, funding risk, and how much of the AI data center cycle is already reflected in the stock see the new level as a reset of expectations rather than a simple price call. As you read on, you will see how to interpret this evolving narrative and what to watch next...

items.title: Charles Schwab, JPMorgan Chase Slide On Vanguard-Backed AI Threat
items.summary: Charles Schwab led a wide swath of brokerage, bank and other financial stocks lower on Tuesday as AI-fueled competition heats up.  Schwab's partnership news with Anthropic last week was meant to address just this kind of disruption, but may have fallen short.  Markets didn't react much on Sept. 1, when Altruist announced its new AI-powered all-in-one financial planning agent, encompassing retirement planning, investment optimization, cash flow analysis, estate planning, tax strategy, and insurance and risk.
